halt_reason: No clean high-confidence one-token-difference relational pair exists because Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct does not reliably perform closed-world 2-hop path composition in a single forward pass. Per protocol, the microscope was kept still: the confidence bar was NOT lowered to force a mappable task.
protocol_clause_invoked: If no clean high-confidence one-token-difference task can be found, STOP and report that rather than weakening the protocol.
success_criterion_note: Phase success does not require positive transfer; a sound negative/HALT with a reproducible diagnostic is a valid outcome.
apparatus_unchanged: Same frozen Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, FP32, eager, deterministic, resid_post convention. carto_lib.py reused unchanged; cartography.py helpers reused unchanged. New entry point cartography_relational.py. No sweep was run (no valid task).

core_finding.description: Across 5 phrasings x 24 entity triples, the model's yes/no answer is essentially INVARIANT to the one-token binding change that flips the ground-truth answer. It anchors on surface phrasing (e.g. answers 'Yes' to everything under one wording, 'No' under another), and the single template with any correct-polarity hits (reach_2steps, 3/24) does so at p~0.3 (chance-level). It does not compute endpoint(rel1)==startpoint(rel2) and compose.
core_finding.implication: There is no reliable relational computation in the model to map. Activation cartography can only chart computations the model actually performs; single-site patching of a task the model cannot do would map noise, not relational binding.

l22_readout_note: The ~L22-23 natural final-position readout hypothesis (stable across 2A L23 / 2B L22 / 2C L22) could NOT be tested here: with no binding-sensitive A/B pair, the natural A/B final-position divergence does not encode a derived-answer difference, so its layer profile is not comparable to the prior phases. The hypothesis therefore remains as of 2C (strengthened across 3 tasks), untested by 2D.
controls_status: N/A (no sweep). The only executed operations were baseline forward passes for task search; deterministic, frozen, no grad, no weight change. Phases 1/2A/2B/2C artifacts untouched.

answers_to_report_questions.1_relational_transfer: Not measured — no valid task (model cannot perform relational composition).
answers_to_report_questions.17_computation_dependent_sites: Consistent-and-extended: 2A/2B/2C already showed writable sites depend on the computation; 2D shows the stronger precondition that a computation must EXIST in the model before its causal anatomy can be mapped.
answers_to_report_questions.18_ambiguous: Whether a larger model (or multi-token entities, or CoT / multi-pass) would perform this task and expose a mappable relational anatomy — untested by design (no model change, no multi-pass).
answers_to_report_questions.19_surprised: The model is near-completely binding-INSENSITIVE (24/24 identical answers under 3 of 5 phrasings), not merely low-accuracy. It is not doing weak relational reasoning; it is doing none, and its output is driven by phrasing prior.
answers_to_report_questions.20_next_anatomical_test: For DISCUSSION only (not executed): either (a) find a relational task this 1.5B model CAN do single-pass (e.g. 1-hop attribute binding / simple coreference) to map genuine binding, or (b) accept that 2-hop composition needs a larger model or multi-pass, which is out of the fixed-microscope scope.

next_step: Discuss with Pete: pick a relational task within the model's single-pass capability, OR change one controlled variable (model size / CoT) deliberately. Do NOT weaken the confidence bar to force 2D.
